result.ca_name_from_pdf: Global Digital Cybersecurity Authority Co., Ltd.
result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline v2.8

disclosed_matters.summary: GDCA issued 20 SSL/TLS certificates from 15 September to 8 October 2023 with the Basic Constraints extension included but not set as Critical, comprising 12 OV certificates, 7 DV certificates, and 1 EV certificate; all certificates had been revoked or expired as of 2 April 2024.
GDCA failed to revoke 13 of the 20 non-critical Basic Constraints certificates within 5 days of receiving the Certificate Problem Report, violating Baseline Requirements 4.9.1.1.
